component.name: Spevox
component.summary: Private, local voice dictation for KDE Plasma

description.p: Spevox provides private local speech recognition, optional local or user-configured AI cleanup, a global hold-to-dictate shortcut, and Wayland-aware text delivery for KDE Plasma.
Renames the app to Spevox, adds the new icon, and keeps existing settings, models, and history working.
Adds project credits, dependency licenses, release checksums, cleaner release binaries, and stronger package checks.
Improves multilingual AI cleanup, model and privacy guidance, History exports, interface responsiveness, private storage, local networking, tests, and release checks.

Adds optional audio history, configurable overlays, Write Mode, app profiles, dictionary tools, statistics, meeting transcription, a local API, Arch packaging, and experimental local speech-server support.
Adds optional local and cloud AI cleanup, Ollama setup, local-only privacy controls, app profiles, selected-text rewriting, Command Mode, History exports, and more audio formats.
Adds Vulkan acceleration, KDE appearance settings, model management, and productivity tools.
Initial development preview with native KDE Wayland dictation, PipeWire capture, local Whisper transcription, and clipboard delivery.
